A service public API must use one model contract or primitive types.

Back to STX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

A service public API must use one model contract or primitive types. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the The Standard family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STX0007: A service public API must use one model contract or primitive types.
public ValueTask<Receipt> AddStudent(Student student, Course course) => default;

Good code example

// Follows STX0007
public ValueTask<Student> AddStudent(Student newStudent) => default;
